title: Charleston Southern cross country announces 2026 fall schedules
text:
Charleston Southern cross country announces 2026 fall schedules
Charleston Southern University Cross Country announced the 2026 fall schedules on July 15, with both men's and women's teams set to compete in six regular season meets.
The Buccaneers will open their season at home with the CSU Buccaneer Open, scheduled for the morning of Friday, September 4. Afterward, the team will travel for four consecutive weekends to participate in meets within South Carolina: the Furman Invitational on September 12, Chanticleer Invitational on September 18, and Winthrop/Adidas Invitational on September 25. The schedule also includes a trip to Pennsylvania for the Paul Short Invitational hosted by Lehigh University on October 2.
The regular season concludes with the Upstate Invitational on October 17. This meet offers Charleston Southern an early look at this year's course that will host the Big South Championships later in October.
USC Upstate is set to host the Big South Championships on Friday, October 30. The same course will be used again for NCAA Southeast Regionals scheduled for Friday, November 13. The NCAA Championships are slated to take place at Indiana State University in Terre Haute, Indiana, on Saturday, November 22.
Fans are encouraged to support Charleston Southern Athletics through membership in the Buc Club. For ongoing updates about CSU athletics programs and events, information is available via X (formerly Twitter), Facebook, Instagram, or directly from csusports.com.
